For a fresh citrus office/daytime scent under ₹5,000, these are the three most practical current options:

Fragrance	Current price	Switching difficulty	Best fit
Marks & Spencer Fresh Mandarin	₹1,499	Low	Easy, clean daytime wear
Ajmal Silver Shade	~₹1,100	Low	Citrus + woody, stronger value
Fragrance World Fresh As Citrus	₹1,899	Medium	More overtly citrus-focused

M&S Fresh Mandarin is the easiest transition if you want something uncomplicated for office use. Ajmal Silver Shade adds more woody/musky character while remaining inexpensive; current listings show ₹1,100. 
Nykaa
+1
 Fresh As Citrus is the more citrus-forward option, but switching may require more adjustment if you prefer subtle office scents.

All three leave substantial budget headroom versus ₹5,000.

df64a5ecd3c4384df69f78b8.answer:
For a first-time handicrafts exporter in Jodhpur, I’d rank onboarding like this:

Option	Onboarding	What to expect
Shiprocket X	⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Easiest	Free signup, company details + KYC, pickup address and wallet. International KYC is typically reviewed in 8–24 hrs. Multiple courier partners. 
Customer Support
+1

DHL Express	⭐⭐⭐⭐	More paperwork, but strong export/customs guidance. Typically requires GSTIN, IEC and AD Code for company exports. MyDHL+ simplifies labels and documentation. 
DHL
+1

FedEx	⭐⭐⭐	Business-account application + PAN, address proof, GSTIN and potentially IEC/LUT/AD documents; a sales rep contacts you. 
FedEx
+1

Best first choice: Shiprocket X for ease and comparing carriers. Choose DHL if reliability and customs support matter more than onboarding simplicity.

Provider / product	Price to budget	Important limitations
MakeMyTrip myBiz	₹0 annual subscription; booking/service fees are contract-specific. A 1.5% payment-gateway fee applies to certain wallet/card repayments. 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	Airline/hotel cancellation rules still apply; GST-invoice availability varies by supplier. 
MakeMyTrip

FCM Travel India	Quote required; no public India tariff.	More comprehensive managed service, with 24/7 support, policy controls, reporting and duty-of-care tools. 
FCM Travel
+1
